title: As Europe Swelters, Event Organizers Face a New Reality: Heat Emergency Planning
summary: Europe's heatwave is forcing organizers to cancel events and rethink attendee safety in real-time. The question is no longer whether extreme heat will disrupt the events calendar; it's whether the industry has built the protocols to respond when it does.

title: London & Partners Faces Cuts, Lands $9.4M Anti-Disinformation Campaign
summary: The Mayor of London is investing millions to try and change how the city is perceived online. London & Partners will run the campaign despite being impacted by funding cuts that curtail its work in attracting business events.

summary: For VIP groups, luxury all-inclusive resorts are emerging that are on par with many top-tier properties in their destination.

title: Helping Build the Events Industry's Next Generation
summary: The Annabelle Project isn't the events industry's first mentorship program, but it may be the first one paying deliberate attention to who the industry has been overlooking.
